lines: Eyes half-open, mind steady, gaze set on the nose-tip — moon and sun themselves dissolved within the triple throb —
a form of light, free of all outside, the one supreme Person: reality attains that state, the highest Real. so it stands, past saying.
sanskrit_cite: ardhoddhāṭitalocanaḥ sthiramanā nāsāgradattekṣaṇaḥ candrārkāvapi līnatāmupagatau trispandabhāvāntare | jyotīrūpamaśeṣabāhyarahitaṃ caikaṃ pumāṃsaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tatpadameti vastu paramam vācyaṃ kimatrādhikam
